main_measure.name: mean position-weighted 2-bar excess return after weekend fall
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and slope > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 100 cases

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 2-bar return on forecast

decided_by: Mean position-weighted excess return is positive with t >= 2 and the regression slope is above 0.
reading: Cases are all bars whose coming bar is Monday with forecast > 0 and close[t+2] in the same window (one per coin per week by construction), the coin mean daily return is pooled over all its windows, the slope is an OLS of the unweighted excess 2-bar return on forecast, and the plan's 'fewer than 100 cases' rule is reported as not observable.
